text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijiiiiiin! Yukino-chaaaan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for rootin' for me~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew~... I did my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(There's even more cheering than at the 
Osaka Hai! Though I still can't say it's 
more than last year...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, yeah, it ain't that simple at all. 
After all, she's sayin' she wants 
everyone's hearts for real.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'll be fine. I know I can do it."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'm definitely going to reach my 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Has Yukino changed somehow...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the Academy after 
commending Yukino Bijin for running her 
heart out—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Good work. I was watching the race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? Aya~, I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino, here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino has... changed a little, hasn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Did I gain weight, or something!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean. How should I put 
it...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I always knew she had guts. But it's not 
just that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Like today, you were running with so 
much confidence.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You really think so? Kinda makes me blush, 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there were a lot of things you 
just couldn't help, though."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, how come you can stay so 
dignified and composed?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An expectant gaze... almost as if she 
believes the answer Yukino Bijin is about 
to give is the very answer she herself has 
been searching for—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umm... Wh-What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I have complete confidence 
or anything, though..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, maybe it's 'cause who I wanna be 
has become clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The person I want to be...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, it was just a coincidence 
that I happened to fit the kind of girl 
everyone liked.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now... I want to become who 
I want to be and learn to love myself. 
That's what I'm runnin' for."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If everyone could come to love the me I 
want to be... That would make me suuuper 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“But that's, like, something without any 
physical form.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How on earth do you decide you've 'made 
it'?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's what I don't freakin' get!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've decided to see this through! 
Even if it takes 100 years, I'll keep on 
runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're strong, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?! Nah, from where I'm standing—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for intruding. ...Get plenty of rest 
today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, City-san?
choice_data_list: I'm sure she has her reasons.
I'm sure she has her reasons.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... City-san is just so 
amazing, after all—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An' so, about the next race I'm gonna 
run...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"My wish hasn't changed! I just wanna put 
on a real cool run in front of a huge 
crowd. That's it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin delivered results at the 
Victoria Mile. If that's the case, we 
should keep aiming to shine even brighter 
on the most dazzling stages――
choice_data_list:
I think the Queen Elizabeth II Cup would 
suit you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen"... wow, that's incredible. 
Sounds seriously powerful...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I just gotta give it my all and do 
my best, just like today!
choice_data_list: Let's show the Classic kids how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see! The younger generation...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...It's makin' me a little excited. I 
wonder what kind of kid is gonna come out?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ! Hishi Ama-san is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon—she currently stands head and 
shoulders above the younger generation. 
With her ability, victory is no mere pipe 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I'll take you on with 
everything I've got! As your senior!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, saying that feels weird when you 
do sooo much for me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though, "senpai", huh? ...Sure has a 
cool ring to it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
